title: Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.28087v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory-based architectures for video object segmentation (VOS) have achieved remarkable performance by maintaining dense feature representations from past frames in a streaming Memory Bank. However, storing these features over time incurs substantial memory overhead and computational cost. In this work, we identify significant temporal redundancy in memory representations, where consecutive frames exhibit highly overlapping low-rank subspaces that remain stable over time. Building on this observation, we propose Memory Subspace Iteration (MSI), a training-free, model-agnostic plugin that exploits temporal subspace stability to efficiently compress streaming memory features. Extensive experiments on standard VOS benchmarks demonstrate that MSI preserves segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures while reducing the memory bank footprint by up to 25%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI_WACV2027.

translated_title: 通过子空间优化实现高效的内存受限视频目标分割
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28087v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：基于内存架构的视频目标分割（VOS）方法通过在流式内存库中维护过去帧的密集特征表示，取得了卓越的性能。然而，随时间推移存储这些特征会带来巨大的内存开销和计算成本。在本工作中，我们发现了内存表示中存在显著的时间冗余，即连续帧的特征呈现出高度重叠且随时间保持稳定的低秩子空间。基于这一观察，我们提出了内存子空间迭代（MSI），这是一种无需训练、与模型无关的插件，利用时间子空间的稳定性来高效压缩流式内存特征。在标准VOS基准上的大量实验表明，MSI在多种架构下均能保持分割精度，同时将内存库的占用最多减少25%。我们的实现已在 https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI_WACV2027 开源。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练、与模型无关的内存子空间迭代（MSI）插件，利用视频帧间低秩子空间的时间稳定性来压缩流式内存特征，在保持分割精度的同时将内存库占用最多减少25%。
